_doc: Needs 0-100 (100 = fully satisfied). They decay per game hour and are refilled by interactions (T-0006). Order here is the display order. Saves store ids, so order does not matter for saves. home (T-0060, T-0077): before free will, a person sees to needs at home: first any need below its critical_below (lowest first), then hygiene below wash_below, hunger below eat_below (or below eat_before_bed in their sleep window, so nobody goes to bed hungry; T-0078), then any other need below low_below (lowest first).
